rv.q: Credit to all the company for allowing us to do just that, albeit for too short a time.
The fleet evening, a 70-minute masterpiece in improvised comedy, has a cast of seven improvising a film based on audience suggestions.
Let's just say that you can’t keep entertainment this fizzy bottled up for long, even as Mischief’s beneficent comic hi-jinks increasingly seem a mark of sanity amidst a year gone wildly wrong.

cn.t: Mischief Theatre's improvised comedy delights with audience-driven movie spoofs that deliver consistent laughs across a brisk 75 minutes, showcasing the troupe's sharp comic skills even amid pandemic uncertainty.
